{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☰]][[fr:Qián]][[ja:乾]][[ko:건 (팔괘)]][[nl:Hemel (trigram)]][[pt:Qián (I Ching)]][[ru:Цянь (триграмма)]][[uk:Цянь (триграма)]][[zh-min-nan:Khiân-kòa]][[zh-yue:乾卦]][[zh:乾卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☰]][[fr:Qián]][[ja:乾]][[ko:건 (팔괘)]][[nl:Hemel (trigram)]][[pt:Qián (I Ching)]][[ru:Цянь (триграмма)]][[uk:Цянь (триграма)]][[zh-min-nan:Khiân-kòa]][[zh-yue:乾卦]][[zh:乾卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|qq=|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|qq=|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☰]][[fr:Qián]][[ja:乾]][[ko:건 (팔괘)]][[nl:Hemel (trigram)]][[pt:Qián (I Ching)]][[ru:Цянь (триграмма)]][[uk:Цянь (триграма)]][[zh-min-nan:Khiân-kòa]][[zh-yue:乾卦]][[zh:乾卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☰]][[fr:Qián]][[ja:乾]][[ko:건 (팔괘)]][[nl:Hemel (trigram)]][[pt:Qián (I Ching)]][[ru:Цянь (триграмма)]][[uk:Цянь (триграма)]][[zh-min-nan:Khiân-kòa]][[zh-yue:乾卦]][[zh:乾卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|qq=draft|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☰]][[fr:Qián]][[ja:乾]][[ko:건 (팔괘)]][[nl:Hemel (trigram)]][[pt:Qián (I Ching)]][[ru:Цянь (триграмма)]][[uk:Цянь (триграма)]][[zh-min-nan:Khiân-kòa]][[zh-yue:乾卦]][[zh:乾卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☰]][[fr:Qián]][[ja:乾]][[ko:건 (팔괘)]][[nl:Hemel (trigram)]][[pt:Qián (I Ching)]][[ru:Цянь (триграмма)]][[uk:Цянь (триграма)]][[zh-min-nan:Khiân-kòa]][[zh-yue:乾卦]][[zh:乾卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

<!--interwikis from wikidata-->[[es:☰]][[fr:Qián]][[ja:乾]][[ko:건 (팔괘)]][[nl:Hemel (trigram)]][[pt:Qián (I Ching)]][[ru:Цянь (триграмма)]][[uk:Цянь (триграма)]][[zh-min-nan:Khiân-kòa]][[zh-yue:乾卦]][[zh:乾卦]] {{afc comment|Wikidata entry [[da:d:Q2384853]] Wikidata name: trigram Qian [[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 08:54, 11 June 2025 (UTC)}} {{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}} {{Bagua|qq=}} '''Qian''' (乾) is one of the [[:en:Bagua|Bagua]]. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the [[:en:Hexagram (I Ching)|Sixty-Four Hexagrams]], known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.
== Trigram Symbolism == Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.
In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in [[:en:Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|Five Elements (Wuxing)]], and the [[:en:East|east]] among the [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five Directions]]. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the [[:en:North|north]]. The Earthly Branches [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.
== Direction == As a [[:en:Cardinal direction|Five directions]], Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the [[:en:Earthly Branches|Earthly Branches]], intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between [[:en:Dog (zodiac)|Dog (戌)]] (*inu*) and [[:en:Pig (zodiac)|Pig (亥)]] (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).
== Earlier Heaven Arrangement == In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing [[:en:South|south]]. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.
