{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|ltq=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|ltq=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east|1=East}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north|1=North}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south|1=South}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east|1=East}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north|1=North}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south|1=South}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east|1=East}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north|1=North}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south|1=South}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|WD=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|WD=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|WD=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|WD=Q684|lt=east|1=East}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|WD=Q659|lt=north|1=North}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|WD=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|WD=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|WD=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|WD=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|WD=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|WD=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|WD=Q667|lt=south|1=South}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.

{{Otheruses|Qian|qq=}}
{{Bagua|qq=}}
'''Qian''' (乾) is one of the {{ill|Bagua|en|Bagua|qid=Q340846|lt=Bagua|1=Bagua}}. Its trigram form is {{resize|125%|'''☰'''|qq=}} and consists of three Yang (⚊) {{ill|Yao (lines)|ja|爻|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yao (lines)|qq=}}. It is also one of the {{ill|Hexagram (I Ching)|en|Hexagram (I Ching)|qid=Q1572403|lt=Sixty-Four Hexagrams|1=Hexagram (I Ching)}}, known as {{ill|Qian as Heaven|ja|乾|1=Qián (Bagua)|2=ja|3=乾|lt=Qian (乾)|1=Qián (Bagua)|lt=Qian為天|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Qian as Heaven|13=User:Immanuelle/Qián (Bagua)|qq=}}, consisting of Qian below and Qian above.

== Trigram Symbolism ==
Qian symbolizes heaven, strength, horses, the head, the father, and the sovereign. As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|qid=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, it represents the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|qid=Q5491373}}.

In the {{ill|Na Jia|ja|納甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Na Jia|qq=}} system, Qian is associated with {{ill|Jia (Heavenly Stem)|ja|甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|1=Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Kinoe (甲)|qq=}}, the Wood element in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Five Elements (Wuxing)|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}, and the {{ill|East|en|East|qid=Q684|lt=east|1=East}} among the {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|qid=Q23718|lt=Five Directions|1=Cardinal direction}}. Alternatively, it can also correspond to {{ill|Ren (Heavenly Stem)|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren (Heavenly Stem)|13=User:Immanuelle/Mizunoe (壬)|qq=}}, the Water element, and the {{ill|North|en|North|qid=Q659|lt=north|1=North}}. The Earthly Branches {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|qid=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|qid=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} are associated with emotions such as crying, joy, happiness, and friendship.

== Direction ==
As a {{ill|Cardinal direction|en|Cardinal direction|qid=Q23718|lt=Five directions|1=Cardinal direction}}, Qian corresponds to the {{ill|northwest|ja|北西|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/northwest|comment=changed title based on wikidata|1=Northwest|qid=Q5491373}}. When the four cardinal directions (east, west, south, north) are divided into twelve parts using the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}}, intermediate directions such as northeast, southeast, southwest, and northwest cannot be fully expressed. To address this, the eight trigrams—{{ill|Kan|ja|坎|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坎|lt=Kǎn (坎)|1=Kǎn (Bagua)|lt=Kan|lt=Kan (☵)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kan|13=User:Immanuelle/Kǎn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Gen|ja|艮|1=Gèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=艮|lt=Gen (艮)|1=Gèn (Bagua)|lt=Gen|lt=Gen (☶)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gen|13=User:Immanuelle/Gèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Zhen|ja|震|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=震|lt=Zhèn (震)|1=Zhèn (Bagua)|lt=Zhen|lt=Zhen (☳)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhen|13=User:Immanuelle/Zhèn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Xun|ja|巽|1=Xùn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=巽|lt=Xun (巽)|1=Xùn (Bagua)|lt=Xun|lt=Xun (☴)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xun|13=User:Immanuelle/Xùn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Li|ja|離|1=Lí (Bagua)|2=ja|3=離|lt=Li (離)|1=Lí (Bagua)|lt=Li|lt=Li (☲)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Li|13=User:Immanuelle/Lí (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Kun|ja|坤|1=Kūn (Bagua)|2=ja|3=坤|lt=Kūn (坤)|1=Kūn (Bagua)|lt=Kun|lt=Kun (☷)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kun|13=User:Immanuelle/Kūn (Bagua)|qq=}}, {{ill|Dui|ja|兌|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|2=ja|3=兌|4=zh-yue|5=兌卦|6=ko|7=태 (괘)|8=fr|9=Duì|10=nl|11=Meer (trigram)|12=pt|13=Duì (I Ching)|14=zh-min-nan|15=Tōe-kòa|lt=Dui (兌)|1=Duì (Bagua)|lt=Dui|lt\=Dui (☱)|lt=Dui (☱)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dui|13=User:Immanuelle/Duì (Bagua)|qq=}}, and Qian (乾)—are used to indicate directions<ref>「[https://www.ndl.go.jp/koyomi/chapter3/s2.html 干支2方位神]」National Diet Library, accessed December 16, 2021.</ref>. Because it lies between {{ill|Dog (zodiac)|en|Dog (zodiac)|qid=Q755126|lt=Dog (戌)|1=Dog (zodiac)}} (*inu*) and {{ill|Pig (zodiac)|en|Pig (zodiac)|qid=Q877261|lt=Pig (亥)|1=Pig (zodiac)}} (*i*), Qian is also read as *Inui* (いぬい).

== Earlier Heaven Arrangement ==
In the {{ill|Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja|伏羲先天八卦|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135491528|1=Fuxi Earlier Heaven Bagua}}, Qian is the first in sequence and is positioned as one of the four cardinal trigrams, representing {{ill|South|en|South|qid=Q667|lt=south|1=South}}. In terms of Yin-Yang transformation, it represents the extreme of Yang.
